attributes.title: SSWR 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Society for Social Work and Research
attributes.organizer: Society for Social Work and Research
attributes.summary:
This is a research meeting first, so it suits social workers who want evidence on interventions and policy more than skills training. Up to 29 CE hours are possible, for a separate $30 nonrefundable fee that has to be paid before the sessions you want to claim.

At our check date NASW approval was still pending, so clinicians relying on these hours for a renewal should confirm first. The early rate ends December 1, 2026. Pre-conference sessions cost extra.
